A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TPV framework and JBR pruning method. All 32 pages of each version, including Appendices A–F, are readable and support comparison of text, equations, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic regression, CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet, and pruning experiments in Section 5 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including TPV stability measurements, label-noise experiments, and pruning comparisons.

M1.justification: The TPV trace formulation, confidence-filtered JBR pruning score, and local noisy-label fine-tuning procedure are unchanged. The revisions explain their applicability rather than introduce different algorithm steps or components.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic teacher tasks, CIFAR-10/100, and ImageNet coverage. The label-noise, SGD-noise, width, sample-size, and pruning scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Figures 9–10 and 15–16 retain the same pruning comparators: Jacobian, L1, BatchNorm scale, FPGM, WHC, Taylor, and Random. No comparator is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix F retain the same splits, architectures, noise levels, metrics, and training settings. Pruning still uses 18 iterations and targets 50% sparsity for ImageNet and 90% for CIFAR. No revised experimental protocol is established.

E4.justification: The width and sample-size sweeps, larger-label-noise experiment, Jacobian-conditioning analysis, and conjugate-gradient failure observations are retained. Figure 7 receives a different explanation but no new robustness test or analysis results.

E5.justification: Repeated-run information and uncertainty displays are unchanged, including 50 Monte Carlo trials in Appendix F.2.1 and five pruning runs in Appendix F.3.4. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-testing practice is added.

E6.justification: All 16 figures retain identical plot content, and the reported numerical results and empirical trends are unchanged. Figure 7 still shows divergent training/test TPV behavior at noise standard deviation 0.1; its interpretation changes rather than its findings.

T1.justification: Appendix C.2 removes v1's assertion that interpolation is incompatible with Theorem 3.2 and revises the mathematical applicability argument: the label-noise formula can remain applicable while large Tr(C) weakens the stability guarantee. The formal theorem statements, displayed derivations, and proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction and conclusion revise the stated stability boundary from first-order validity to sufficiently small induced perturbations or covariance. The abstract also emphasizes independence from generalization performance, already discussed in v1. The central TPV and JBR contributions remain intact.

C2.justification: Sections 3.1 and 5.2 and Appendix C.2 replace v1's explanation that Figure 7 lies outside the linearized theory with a conjecture that large perturbation covariance weakens the stability bound. v2 consequently distinguishes applicability of the label-noise formula from reliability of training TPV as a robustness estimator.

D1.justification: Appendix C.3.4 changes the guidance that BatchNorm and dropout should not be present to guidance that they should not be active during eval-mode fine-tuning. Both versions already report eval-mode training in Appendix F, so this clarifies implementation instructions rather than establishes a changed experiment. Code-access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including the distinction between local TPV and global prediction variance and the relationship between JBR and the Jacobian Criterion.

P1.justification: There are focused revisions to the abstract, introduction, stability discussion, conclusion, and Appendix C.2, alongside typographical and notation corrections. The overall section organization and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, axes, legends, and captions are retained, with limited spacing and text-flow changes. The conclusion now continues onto page 11 and references reflow. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves coherence by removing the contradictory interpolation-incompatibility assertion in Appendix C.2 and distinguishing a weak stability bound from failure of the label-noise approximation. It also clarifies eval-mode implementation guidance. These are limited improvements: the proposed covariance explanation for Figure 7 remains conjectural, with no new evidence establishing that mechanism.
